items.title: Buster Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: Also, as Duke Ellington said, one of the greatest reasons to have a band is so that you can hear your stuff.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know I’ve been trying to be really busy with that band since 1990. I did an album for a label, In and Out Records, a label out of Germany. I did it in 1987. And it was released in Europe and Asia until 1995 when it was released here. But I did that album and I wrote out a majority of the music for it, Herbie Hancock was on it, Wayne Shorter, Al Foster, trumpet player named Shunzo Ohno. And after doing the album, six months later I still liked it. You know? I mean you know how when you’re working on…
